summary: PM get_status uses get_budget_snapshot (UTC day rollover) instead of raw load_budget_spend so prior-day spend.json no longer reports false critical budget_pressure and 100% burn (#634/#660).
migration_impact: Local only. Operators may still see stale counters inside .agentic/budget/spend.json until the next charge rewrites today's date; status/pressure surfaces now ignore prior UTC days.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / pull release with this fix.
2. Re-run plate_pm_status / get_pm_status; budget_pressure should be ok when spend.json date is not today.
3. Optional: delete or rewrite .agentic/budget/spend.json if local test debris remains (file is gitignored).
agent_notes: Always prefer get_budget_snapshot for remaining/pressure/burn. Never derive PM pressure from raw spend.json without spend_is_today. what_next ranks PM after budget pressure clears.
